title: MZ Collision Maps / pixel movement in RPG MZ?

posts.author: Zykles
posts.body: Hey, I have used the ported Luna QMovement and Qcollisionmaps for my project, but i'm coming to a point in my project where these unfinished ports are not really cutting it due to the incompatibilities that come from it never being fully ported. As far as I can see, the full port was never made, so i'm looking for alternatives. What else can I use for pixel movement and/or collision maps in MZ where I can still have the party follow behind in the overworld?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Tyruswoo has a MZ port of Altimit and a Follower Control Plugin so you can make them move however you want
Tyruswoo Altimit Movement MZ | Tyruswoo Studio
Plugin for RPG Maker MZ. Add pixel movement to your game! Includes a command to recalculate tile boundaries, for compatibility with Tile Control MZ!
www.tyruswoo.com
Follower Control MZ | Tyruswoo Studio
Plugin for RPG Maker MZ. Provides greater control of party follower movement! Allows event commands targeting the “player” to affect any follower of your choosing! Plus, unlimited followers!
www.tyruswoo.com
